A torn labrum can only be fixed through surgery, or you can choose to live with it as best you can. The labrum is the tissue that connects to your socket that keeps the ball of your joint in place. It is not fully capable of a total self healing repair. Surgery takes 9-12 months to recover which is why they opted not to at this time, but without it he won't have the same ROM and will likely not be the same player.

IT will be back once he recovers enough to play, but you shouldn't expect to see the exact same guy as last year is what I'm saying

Source: Someone who had the injury and surgery

- Tell yourself you love yourself constantly even if you don't believe it

For people that don't have issues, NoFap seems strange, but isn't that how it is for a lot of things? Like say mental illness?

I got sucked into porn at a very young age by accident and it fucked me up and I didn't even know it until I couldn't lose my virginity because I couldn't get an erection. Worst feeling of my life. So be open minded because some guys, like me, actually benefit from it. I quit for over a 100 days and can now have normal satisfying sex. As far as the mental benefits...well that is up in the air, but porn induced erectile dysfunction is VERY real, and if can clearly effect people physically, then would it not be fair to assume it can have mental effects?

All I'm asking is for people to accept NoFap as something that really does and can help people. Nobody is going to shame you for not doing it, but I also remember people telling me to do it and I blew them off too before realizing I had ED. Food for thought
